### Problem 1

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(patchwork)
library(ggridges)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.asp = .6,
  out.width = "90%"
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

options(
  ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis",
  ggplot2.continuous.fill = "viridis"
)
```

```{r load_noaa}
data("ny_noaa")
```

```{r }
## A noaa sumnary
n_rows = nrow(ny_noaa)
n_cols = ncol(ny_noaa)
n_stations = n_distinct(pull(ny_noaa, id))
first_date = min(pull(ny_noaa, date))
last_date = max(pull(ny_noaa, date))
pct_missing_prcp = round(mean(is.na(pull(ny_noaa, prcp))) * 100, 1)
pct_missing_snow = round(mean(is.na(pull(ny_noaa, snow))) * 100, 1)
pct_missing_tmax = round(mean(is.na(pull(ny_noaa, tmax))) * 100, 1)
```

The dataset contains daily weather records from 747 weather stations in New York, from 1981-01-01 to 2010-12-31. It has 2595176 rows and 7 columns. Missing data is a major issue, especially for maximum temperature, 43.7% of values are missing, compared with 14.7% of snowfall and 5.6% of precipitation values.

```{r}
## Data cleaning
ny_noaa |> drop_na(tmax) |> pull(tmax) |> head()

noaa_df =
  ny_noaa |> separate(date, into = c("year", "month", "day"), sep = "-") |>
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    month = as.numeric(month),
    day = as.numeric(day),
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    prcp = prcp / 10)
```
